summary: Drop User.nickname: the column (a new migration; SQLite redefines the User table), UserDto.nickname in the API, and every use in seed, service, tests and README. The column data is lost (Irfan agreed).

acceptance.text: User has no nickname column: prisma/schema.prisma drops it and a new migration under prisma/migrations redefines the User table without it
GET /users and GET /users/:id answer without nickname (UserDto has no nickname)
Every other User column, DTO field and endpoint answers as before; npm run db:test:reset works

tasks.title: drop User.nickname (schema, migration, API, seed, tests)
steps: In test/users.e2e-spec.ts make the GET /users/:id test expect the user without nickname (toEqual {id, email, name}) and drop nickname from the GET /users first-page toMatchObject; change only nickname lines
Run npm run test:e2e -- test/users.e2e-spec.ts: red

Remove nickname from model User in prisma/schema.prisma; write the new migration prisma/migrations/<timestamp>_drop_user_nickname/migration.sql from ./node_modules/.bin/prisma migrate diff --from-migrations prisma/migrations --to-schema prisma/schema.prisma --script
Remove nickname from prisma/seed.ts, from UserDto in src/users/users.dto.ts, from the select in src/users/users.service.ts and from the README ER diagram
Run npm run test:e2e -- test/users.e2e-spec.ts: green; then npm run typecheck, npm test and npm run db:test:reset

facts: prisma/seed.ts: every 3rd user gets nickname nick<n>
src/users/users.dto.ts: UserDto.nickname is in the GET /users and GET /users/:id responses
test/users.e2e-spec.ts: two tests assert nickname nick1
prisma/migrations/20261007134900_init/migration.sql: SQLite; a dropped column means a table redefine (new_User, copy, drop, rename)

decisions.text: May the data in User.nickname be lost? → yes: drop it, no backup
Does any API client read nickname? → none: remove it now, no deprecation step
The migration SQL comes from prisma migrate diff, not written by hand
